notes.title: ENDER MAGNOLIA Release announcement
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725260/ENDER_MAGNOLIA_Bloom_in_the_Mist

Thank you for playing ENDER LILIES!

Thanks to everyone's support, we were able to release the
spiritual sequel of the game: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist.
It would not have been possible without you, and we would like to offer our sincerest gratitude.

[b]▼ About ENDER MAGNOLIA[/b]

The events of ENDER MAGNOLIA take place in the same world as ENDER LILIES,
but it was designed with the goal of making it enjoyable even for people who
didn't play the first game.
As it is the same world set in a near future, we have also included a few connections
to the first game that we hope will please fans of ENDER LILIES.

We think we were able to better express the story, implement more engaging game systems
and add quality of life features that we were not able to put in ENDER LILIES.
Whether you played ENDER LILIES or not, we hope you will play and enjoy ENDER MAGNOLIA !


The development team

[previewyoutube=Q9wD4brP7nA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The sequel to acclaimed Metroidvania Ender Lilies gets PC early access release
notes.content:
Out of all the Nintendo Direct announcements last week, the one I was most sad to see not get a PC release date was the sequel to the much beloved Metroidvania Ender Lilies. The announcement came as a bit of a surprise, all told, and I was worried I'd have to consign it to what I've now dubbed my Unicorn Overlord pile of games that are never coming to PC. Happily, publishers Binary Haze Interactive have now confirmed that Ender Magnolia: Bloom In The Mist is, in fact, coming to PC (and other consoles) after all, and that it's coming real soon, as its PC early access release has been set for just weeks away on March 25th. Result.

notes.title: Nintendo reveals the top-selling indie games on Switch for 2021
notes.content:
Nintendo’s Indie World recently put out a video summing up the best-selling indie games for 2021 (thanks Kotaku), and it’s got some real gems in it. Though we don’t know ranking for sure, the video featured both familiar faces and new challengers.

The complete list in order of appearance is as follows:

Some of these games aren’t surprises. Tetris Effect, Spelunky 2, and Subnautica are just some of the more recognizable names. But appearing alongside them are newer IP like Unpacking, Ender Lilies, and Eastward, all games that have reviewed really well but were unproven entities sales-wise until now.

notes.title: Лили и бессмертные рыцари: Обзор ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
notes.content: Инди-сцена достаточно плотно взялась за развитие жанра метроидваний. И если несколько лет назад все как безумные делали хорроры от первого лица, то теперь небольшие команды стараются поразить очередным убийцей Shovel Knight, хардкорной JRPG или космическим переосмыслением Souls-игр. Новый проект от японской и канадской студий Live Wire и Adglobe Tokyo представляет собой очередную метроидванию в стилистике 2D Dark Souls.

notes.title: Castlevania-like Ender Lilies summons a full launch with new bosses today
notes.content:
Metroidvania-y action RPG Ender Lilies: Quietus Of The Knights has defeated the early access beast in short order and emerged with a full launch today. Since its original early access state from January, the very pretty spirit combat game has added five new areas, new bosses, and more. You can spot some of the combat and lovely art style here in its launch day trailer.

Read more

notes.title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights v1.0 is Now Live!
notes.content:
[i]ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights[/i] v1.0 is now available! Five more areas have been added to those available in Early Access, bringing the total up to eight. More bosses stand ready to be defeated and join Lily’s side. Her spirit companions can all be fully upgraded, new secrets lurk in the shadows waiting to be found, and the story can now be completed.

Players who have purchased ENDER LILIES in Steam Early Access will receive the v1.0 update at no cost.

Furthermore, save data from Early Access will carry over into the full game. However, since updates have been made to the opening and tutorial we recommend starting over from the beginning.

Our beautiful soundtrack from musical group [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mili_(musical_group)]Mili[/url], who has contributed tracks to acclaimed anime franchises including [i]Ghost in the Shell[/i] and [i]Goblin Slayer[/i] as well as rhythm games such as [i]Cytus[/i] and [i]Deemo[/i], is also available today. You can get it here on Steam, check it out on your favorite streaming service, and find it on a variety of other music storefronts.

Once again, we’d like to give a massive shout out to everyone who has supported us so far. Thank you for giving [i]ENDER LILIES[/i] a chance in Early Access, and to everyone who has made time to share feedback with us. You have helped us make [i]ENDER LILIES[/i] a better game and we are so excited to hear everyone’s thoughts on the full experience.

We know some of you have eagerly been asking about physical editions and additional content. Now that the game is out, we can think about adding more in future updates. Please keep an eye on our [url=https://twitter.com/EnderLiliesGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/EnderLilies/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/enderliliesgame/]Instagram[/url] pages for news, as we’ll shout from the rooftops about further developments on social media.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/a802ac0cf88c6443240541942aab71a6ae35654a.png[/img]
Illus.Ayumi Yamada（Concept Artist/Cutscene Artist）

[list]

[*]new player skills
[*] new relics
[*] new parry action relic
[*] new "Last Rites" system (super attack)

notes.title: ENDER LILIES v1.0 Will Launch June 22!
notes.content:
[i]ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights[/i] will get its v1.0 update on June 22, 2021!

The rest of the story and content will be released at that time. Between now and then, we'll still be working on bugs for the content available in Early Access, so keep an eye out for patches if you're having trouble with the game.

Thank you so much to everyone who has supported us so far, whether through wishlisting, buying and playing the game, or going the extra mile to give us feedback on what you like so far or want to see improved. We look forward to getting the final version into your hands and hope you'll enjoy the full experience and the end of Lily's story!

notes.title: 0.7.0 Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/fa3b26568ff089a7c749ee4fc148ec50e03088d3.png[/img]

Thank you for playing ENDER LILIES! We are working hard towards the official release.

For players waiting for new content, we apologize for the wait, but we would like add all the new areas as part of the official release

As a first step, based on feedback we received from all of you since the beginning of the early access, we made some changes to the game systems in hopes of making the gameplay experience more enjoyable. Those changes are described in detail below.

Thank you again to everyone who has played ENDER LILIES, and especially to those of you who have taken the time to share your opinions with us!


[h1][b]New[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Add a new "Hold" mode for summon set switch that can be activated in the game settings
[*]Allow binding of mouse buttons in keyboard settings
[*]Allow binding of UI inputs in keyboard settings
[*]Add a "Hide UI" option in pause menu
[*]Add options to hide player UI, enemies floating gauges in game settings
[/list]
[h1][b]Adjustments[/b][/h1]
[h2][u]■Gameplay[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Change most "Interaction" input to not require directional press 
(pick up an item, activate switch, restpoint)
[*]Adjust camera speed when using the auto climb action
[*]Update some UI elements
[*]Allow wrap in most menus
[*]Add footer in most menus
[*]Zoom out minimap for better visibility
[*]Update effects used for items obtained
[*]Change conversations in events to proceed by player input instead of automatically
[*]Update effects and animations when a skill can be used
[/list]
[h2][u]■Player[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Update underwater action :
[*]Allow underwater dodge after obtaining 「Witch's Bubble」
[*]Allow diving underwater while swimming horizontally by pressing ↓
[*]Allow falling through platforms while moving
[*]Update player knockback :
[*]landing recovery animation can be cancelled by dodge or attack action
[*]Update double jump effect
[*]Update and brush up some player's animations
[*]Update effect of heal action to follow player's location
[/list]
[h2][u]■Spirits[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]「Headless Defender」
- Decrease recast time
- Decrease invincibility time after use
- Increase range
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
[*]「Umbral Knight」
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
[*]「Cliffside Hamlet Youth」
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
[*]「Gerrod, the Elder Warrior」
- Adjust effect display to match attack range
[/list]
[h2][u]■Relics[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]「Ruined Witch's Book」
- Decrease the effect of underwater movement speed bonus
[/list]

[h2][u]■Enemy[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduce contact damages
[*]Adjust some enemies hitbox
[*]Adjust some magic projectiles' speed and trajectory
[*]Add attack motions to some enemies

notes.title: ENDER LILIES Early Access Launch and Next Steps
notes.content:
In spite of some technical difficulties with the launch, we’re happy to have been able to get [i]ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights[/i] into everyone’s hands. With your support, [i]ENDER LILIES[/i] climbed the ranks to the top of the Steam top sellers list, and we’ve gotten an Overwhelmingly Positive rating from users. Thank you so much!

Now that feedback is rolling in, we’re gradually learning about some of the issues facing us to make [i]ENDER LILIES[/i] as awesome as possible. We’re carefully considering the information and opinions you’re giving us as we improve the game ahead of its v1.0 launch in Q2 2021.

If you have any additional comments or suggestions, please reach out to us through the Steam Community forums. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights Available in Steam Early Access on Jan. 21
notes.content:
When we revealed [i]ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights[/i], we told you to expect it in Winter 2020. As development has continued, we’ve realized we need more time to give you the best possible dark fantasy metroidvania experience.

We know you’re eager to get your hands on [i]ENDER LILIES[/i] and we don’t want to keep you waiting, so we’ve decided to bring the game to Steam Early Access on Jan. 21. We’re starting by releasing the first three areas out of at least eight total in the final game.

During early access we’d love to hear from you - please head over to the Discussions here on Steam and let us know what you think! We’ll have subforms for bug reporting and feedback.

Alongside this news, we have also announced that in addition to a soundtrack from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mili_(musical_group)]Mili[/url], who have contributed to anime franchises including [i]Ghost in the Shell[/i] and [i]Goblin Slayer[/i] as well as rhythm games like [i]Cytus[/i] and [i]Deemo[/i], the sound effects come from former Sega producer [url=https://segaretro.org/Keiichi_Sugiyama]Keiichi Sugiyama[/url]. Sugiyama-san has worked on franchises like [i]Rez[/i] and [i]Skies of Arcadia[/i] as part of his illustrious career.

In case you missed it, we've been teasing details about gameplay on our [url=https://twitter.com/EnderLiliesGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/EnderLilies/]Facebook pages[/url], and we'll continue to do so leading up to launch. You can keep up to date with all the latest news, ask questions for the devs, and hang out with us there or in our Steam Discussions.

In the meantime, we wish you all happy new year while awaiting the release of [i]ENDER LILIES[/i]!
